output.reason: [ev-0fe6816db4bb] does not say the UseStrimziPodSets feature gate is deprecated. It describes a step operators must take first: when upgrading the Kafka operand from Strimzi 0.34 or older, enable the gate and use StrimziPodSet resources before upgrading. That makes this a mandatory migration step, not a feature-gate deprecation. The nearby items in the same section, such as [ev-17b3774eb9ee], are worded the same way as pre-upgrade requirements.

correction.statement: Before upgrading the Kafka operand from Strimzi 0.34 or older, operators must enable the UseStrimziPodSets feature gate and make sure StrimziPodSet resources are used.
